UMAP of Patients Coloured by Risk Group

Source: R/visualizations.R
plot_umap.Rd

Projects patients into two dimensions with umap and colours them by the risk group from patient_stratification. The projection is restricted to the features of the given model: selected_features() for models with built-in selection (Cox penalised models) and top_features() for importance-based models ("blockForest", "flexynesis"); the choice is made from model. Assay samples are matched to stratified patients by barcode.

Usage

plot_umap(
  mae,
  x,
  model,
  modality = NULL,
  top_feat = NULL,
  mae_train = NULL,
  features = NULL,
  experiment = NULL,
  assay = 1,
  colors = .risk_colors(),
  rho = NULL,
  scale = TRUE,
  n_neighbors = 15,
  seed = 42,
  ...
)

Arguments

mae

A MultiAssayExperiment providing the feature matrix to project (typically the stratified test object).

x

Either the list returned by patient_stratification or its strata data.frame.

model

Character string naming the model whose features drive the projection (e.g. "cox_lasso", "blockForest", "flexynesis").

modality

Character string naming the omics modality. It locates a penalised model's selected features (ignored for "blockForest" / "flexynesis") and, unless experiment is given, also selects the assay to project on. Default is NULL: the single per-run integration tag ("early_<omics>") is then resolved automatically; pass the tag (or an omic name) explicitly to disambiguate.

top_feat

Integer number of top features to keep. Used only when model is "blockForest" or "flexynesis"; ignored otherwise. If NULL (default), top_features's own default is used.

mae_train

A MultiAssayExperiment from which to read the model's features. Defaults to mae; set this when feature information lives in the training object.

features

Optional character vector of feature (row) names. If supplied, it overrides the automatic retrieval from model.

experiment

Name or index of the experiment to project on. If NULL (default), the assay matching modality is used, or the single "early_*" integration assay when modality is NULL (joint models).

assay

Assay index or name within experiment. Default is 1.

colors

Named character vector mapping risk groups to colours. Default is c("High risk" = "red", "Low risk" = "deepskyblue").

rho

Numeric. For model = "AFTCoop" only: selects the beta_rho_<rho> feature set. If NULL (default) and only one rho was trained, it is resolved automatically.

scale

Logical. If TRUE, features are standardised and zero-variance features are dropped. Default is TRUE.

n_neighbors

Integer UMAP neighbourhood size. Default is 15.

seed

Integer random seed for reproducibility. Default is 42.

...

Additional arguments passed to umap.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Feature information (selected features / variable importance) is a training artifact, so it is read from mae_train. The projection itself is drawn on mae (typically the stratified test set).

See also

patient_stratification, plot_km, top_features, selected_features
